preconditions.description: The size of the grid n must be between 1 and 2000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == n for row in grid)
preconditions.description: Each row in the grid must have exactly n characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'SG.' for row in grid for c in row)
preconditions.description: Each character in the grid must be either 'S', 'G', or '.'.

postconditions.description: The output must be one of the specified strings indicating the uniqueness of the solution.
If the output is 'UNIQUE', it must be followed by n lines representing the completed mosaic.
If the output is 'NONE', it must be a single line indicating no valid mosaic can be created.
If the output is 'MULTIPLE', it must be a single line indicating multiple valid mosaics can be created.
If the output is 'UNIQUE', the n lines following it must represent a valid mastapeece where each tile is adjacent to exactly 2 tiles of the same color.
postconditions.expression: stdout == 'UNIQUE' and all(all(grid[i][j] in 'SG' for j in range(n)) for i in range(n)) and all(sum(1 for di, dj in [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)] if 0 <= i + di < n and 0 <= j + dj < n and grid[i + di][j + dj] == grid[i][j]) == 2 for i in range(n) for j in range(n))

postconditions.description: If the output is 'UNIQUE', the grid must match the input grid where tiles are already placed.
postconditions.expression: stdout == 'UNIQUE' and all(grid[i][j] == input_grid[i][j] or input_grid[i][j] == '.' for i in range(n) for j in range(n))
